requirements.quote: All glazing materials, including glazing material for the manufacture of windscreens, shall be such that, in the event of shattering, the danger of bodily injury is reduced as far as possible
requirements.text: The laminated windscreen and side glazing shall be designed so that, in the event of shattering, the danger of bodily injury is reduced as far as possible.

requirements.quote: The glazing material shall be sufficiently resistant to the incidents likely to occur in normal traffic, and to atmospheric and temperature conditions, chemical action, combustion and abrasion
requirements.text: The glazing material shall be sufficiently resistant to the incidents likely to occur in normal traffic and to atmospheric and temperature conditions, chemical action, combustion and abrasion.

requirements.quote: Safety glazing materials shall in addition be sufficiently transparent, shall not cause any noticeable distortions of objects as seen through the windscreen
requirements.text: The safety glazing shall be sufficiently transparent and shall not cause any noticeable distortion of objects as seen through the windscreen.

requirements.quote: shall not give rise to any confusion between the colours used in road-traffic signs and signals
requirements.text: The safety glazing shall not give rise to any confusion between the colours used in road-traffic signs and signals.

requirements.quote: In the event of the windscreen's shattering, the driver shall still be able to see the road clearly enough to be able to brake and stop his vehicle safely
requirements.text: The laminated windscreen shall retain sufficient residual visibility after shattering that the driver can see the road clearly enough to brake and stop the vehicle safely.

requirements.quote: Every piece of safety glazing material, including the samples and test pieces submitted for approval, shall bear a trade name or mark of the manufacturer
requirements.text: Every piece of safety glazing, including samples and test pieces, shall bear a trade name or mark of the manufacturer.

requirements.quote: The marking shall be clearly legible and indelible
requirements.text: The manufacturer's trade name or mark on each piece of glazing shall be clearly legible and indelible.

requirements.quote: There shall be affixed conspicuously to every piece of glazing and multiple-glazed unit conforming to a type approved under this Regulation
requirements.text: An international approval mark shall be affixed conspicuously to every piece of glazing conforming to the approved type.

requirements.quote: A circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval
requirements.text: The approval mark on the glazing shall consist of a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which granted approval.

requirements.quote: The number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle prescribed in paragraph 5.4.1.
requirements.text: The approval mark shall show the number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle.

requirements.quote: In the case of a windscreen: I for toughened glass, II for ordinary laminated glass, III for treated laminated glass, IV for glass-plastics glazing
requirements.text: The ordinary laminated-glass windscreen shall bear the additional symbol II near the approval mark.

requirements.quote: V in the case of safety glazing having a regular light transmittance less than 70 per cent
requirements.text: Any glazing having a regular light transmittance less than 70 per cent shall bear the additional symbol V near the approval mark.

requirements.quote: XI In the case of laminated-glass panes. In addition, the appropriate application will be signified by: /D For laminated-glass panes with enhanced mechanical properties
requirements.text: Laminated-glass side panes shall bear the additional symbol XI, and where they have enhanced mechanical properties the additional symbol /D.

requirements.quote: The approval mark and symbol shall be clearly legible and be indelible. Additional symbols shall be combined within the approval marking.
requirements.text: The approval mark and the additional symbols shall be clearly legible and indelible and the additional symbols shall be combined within the approval marking.

requirements.quote: a = 8 mm minimum
requirements.text: The characters of the approval mark shall be at least 8 mm high.

requirements.quote: A reference such as A4/3 in the table indicates the annex (4) and paragraph (3) of that annex, where the relevant test is described
requirements.text: The ordinary laminated-glass windscreen shall be subjected to the headform test of Annex 6 paragraph 3 and to the 2,260 g ball test of Annex 6 paragraph 4.2.

requirements.quote: 227 g ball
requirements.text: The toughened-glass side panes shall be subjected to the 227 g ball test of Annex 5 paragraph 3.1 and the fragmentation test of Annex 5 paragraph 2.

requirements.quote: Light transmission A3/9.1
requirements.text: The windscreen and the side glazing shall be subjected to the light transmission measurement of Annex 3 paragraph 9.1.

requirements.quote: Secondary image A3/9.3
requirements.text: The laminated windscreen shall be subjected to the secondary-image-separation test of Annex 3 paragraph 9.3.

requirements.quote: Optional distortion
requirements.text: The laminated windscreen shall be subjected to the optical distortion evaluation of Annex 3 paragraph 9.2.

requirements.quote: Resistance to chemicals A3/11.2.1
requirements.text: The windscreen and side glazing shall be subjected to the resistance-to-chemicals immersion test of Annex 3 paragraph 11.2.1.

requirements.quote: A safety glazing material shall be approved if it meets all the requirements prescribed in the relevant provisions referred to in the paragraphs 8.2.1.1 and 8.2.1.2.
requirements.text: The safety glazing shall meet all the requirements of the tests prescribed for its type in the applicable table before it is placed on the market.

requirements.quote: To obtain fragmentation, a hammer of about 75 g or some other appliance giving equivalent results shall be used. The radius of curvature of the point shall be 0.2 ± 0.05 mm.
requirements.text: For the fragmentation test the toughened side pane shall be broken with a hammer of about 75 g whose point radius of curvature is 0.2 ± 0.05 mm.

requirements.quote: The glass pane to be tested shall not be rigidly secured; it may however be fastened on an identical glass pane by means of adhesive tape applied all round the edge.
requirements.text: The tempered side-window pane under fragmentation test shall not be rigidly secured but may be taped all round the edge to an identical pane.

requirements.quote: Permanent recording of the fragmentation pattern shall start within 10 seconds and shall end within 3 minutes after the impact.
requirements.text: The fragmentation pattern of the tempered side pane shall be permanently recorded starting within 10 seconds and ending within 3 minutes after the impact.

requirements.quote: Hardened-steel ball with a mass of 227 g ± 2 g and a diameter of approximately 38 mm.
requirements.text: The 227 g ball test shall be performed with a hardened-steel ball of mass 227 g ± 2 g and diameter approximately 38 mm.

requirements.quote: When a device to project the ball is used, the tolerance on velocity shall be ±1 per cent of the velocity equivalent to that obtained by the free fall.
requirements.text: Where the ball is projected rather than dropped, the velocity tolerance shall be within ±1 per cent of the free-fall equivalent velocity.

requirements.quote: with machined borders 15 mm wide, fitting one over the other and faced with rubber gaskets about 3 mm thick and 15 mm wide and of hardness 50 IRHD
requirements.text: The ball-impact support fixture shall have machined borders 15 mm wide faced with rubber gaskets about 3 mm thick, 15 mm wide and of hardness 50 IRHD.

requirements.quote: Temperature: 20 °C ± 5 °C Pressure: 860 to 1,060 mbar Relative humidity: 60 ± 20 per cent
requirements.text: The 227 g ball test on the glazing shall be conducted at 20 °C ± 5 °C, 860 to 1,060 mbar and 60 ± 20 per cent relative humidity.

requirements.quote: The test piece shall be a flat square of side 300 + 10/-0 mm or shall be cut from the flattest part of a windscreen or other curved pane.
requirements.text: The ball-test specimen shall be a flat square of side 300 +10/-0 mm or cut from the flattest part of the windscreen or other curved pane.

requirements.quote: Condition the test piece at the specified temperature for at least four hours immediately preceding the test.
requirements.text: The glazing test piece shall be conditioned at the specified temperature for at least four hours immediately preceding the ball test.

requirements.quote: The plane of the test piece shall be perpendicular, within 3°, to the incident direction of the ball.
requirements.text: During the 227 g ball test the plane of the test piece shall be perpendicular within 3° to the incident ball direction.

requirements.quote: The point of impact shall be within 25 mm of the geometric centre of the test piece for a drop height less than or equal to 6 m
requirements.text: The ball shall strike within 25 mm of the geometric centre of the test piece when the drop height is 6 m or less.

requirements.quote: The ball shall strike that face of the test piece which represents the outside face of the safety glazing pane when mounted on the vehicle.
requirements.text: In the 227 g ball test the ball shall strike the face of the test piece representing the outside face of the glazing as mounted on the vehicle.

requirements.quote: The ball shall be allowed to make only one impact.
requirements.text: The ball shall be allowed to make only one impact on the test piece.

requirements.quote: Hardened-steel ball with a mass of 2,260 g ± 20 g and a diameter of approximately 82 mm.
requirements.text: The 2,260 g ball test on the laminated windscreen shall be performed with a hardened-steel ball of mass 2,260 g ± 20 g and diameter approximately 82 mm.

requirements.quote: The ball shall strike that face of the test piece which represents the inward face of the safety-glass pane when the latter is mounted on the vehicle.
requirements.text: In the 2,260 g ball test the ball shall strike the face of the test piece representing the inward face of the glazing as mounted on the vehicle.

requirements.quote: The point of impact shall be within 25 mm of the geometric centre of the test piece.
requirements.text: The 2,260 g ball shall strike within 25 mm of the geometric centre of the test piece.

requirements.quote: The total mass of the apparatus shall be 10 kg ± 0.2 kg.
requirements.text: The headform weight used in the headform test shall have a total mass of 10 kg ± 0.2 kg.

requirements.quote: faced with rubber gaskets about 3 mm thick and 15 mm ± 1 mm wide and of hardness 70 IRHD
requirements.text: The flat-test-piece headform support frames shall be faced with rubber gaskets about 3 mm thick, 15 mm ± 1 mm wide and of hardness 70 IRHD.

requirements.quote: The flat test piece, having a length of 1,100 + 5/-2 mm and a widthof 500 + 5/-2 mm
requirements.text: The flat headform test piece shall have a length of 1,100 +5/-2 mm and a width of 500 +5/-2 mm.

requirements.quote: the torque on the bolts shall ensure that the movement of the test piece during the test will not exceed 2 mm
requirements.text: The test piece shall be clamped in the headform support so that its movement during the test does not exceed 2 mm.

requirements.quote: The weight shall strike the test piece within 40 mm of its geometric centre on that face which represents the inward face of the safety glazing
requirements.text: The headform weight shall strike within 40 mm of the geometric centre of the test piece on the face representing the inward face of the glazing.

requirements.quote: The impact surface of the felt cover shall be replaced after 12 tests.
requirements.text: The felt cover of the headform shall be replaced after every 12 impacts.

requirements.quote: acceleration gauges, measuring and recording instruments according to ISO 6487, channel-amplitude class CAC 5,000 m/s² and channel-frequency class CFC 1,000 Hz
requirements.text: The HIC measuring instrumentation shall use acceleration gauges and recording instruments of ISO 6487 channel-amplitude class CAC 5,000 m/s² and channel-frequency class CFC 1,000 Hz.

requirements.quote: Before each test series and no later than each 50 tests within a series, the phantom head shall be calibrated and adjusted if necessary.
requirements.text: The phantom head shall be calibrated and adjusted if necessary before each test series and no later than every 50 tests within a series.
When dropped from 50, 100, 150 and 254 mm on the impact plate, the phantom head's greatest z-axis deceleration shall be 82 ± 8, 128 ± 8, 167 ± 10 and 227 ± 14 times g respectively.

requirements.quote: The acceleration components ax and ay should be smaller for vertical impact than 0.1 az.
requirements.text: For the vertical headform impact the recorded lateral acceleration components ax and ay shall be less than 0.1 az.

requirements.quote: A horizontal turntable, with centre clamp, which revolves counter-clockwise at a fixed speed of 60 ± 2 rev/min or 72 ± 2 rev/min
requirements.text: The Taber abraser turntable shall revolve counter-clockwise at a fixed speed of 60 ± 2 rev/min or 72 ± 2 rev/min.

requirements.quote: each wheel rests on the test specimen under the pressure exerted by a mass of 500 g
requirements.text: Each abrasive wheel shall rest on the test specimen under the pressure exerted by a mass of 500 g.

requirements.quote: each wheel shall be 12.7 mm ± 0.3 mm wide and have an external diameter of less than 52.5 mm and in no case less than 44.4 mm
requirements.text: Each abrasive wheel shall be 12.7 mm ± 0.3 mm wide with an external diameter less than 52.5 mm and not less than 44.4 mm.

requirements.quote: Temperature: 23 °C ± 2 °C Pressure: 860 to 1,060 mbar Relative humidity: 50 ± 5 per cent.
requirements.text: The abrasion test shall be conducted at 23 °C ± 2 °C, 860 to 1,060 mbar and 50 ± 5 per cent relative humidity.

requirements.quote: The test pieces shall be flat squares of side 100 mm having both surfaces substantially plane and parallel
requirements.text: The abrasion test pieces shall be flat squares of side 100 mm with both surfaces substantially plane and parallel.

requirements.quote: The abrasion test shall be carried out on that surface of the test piece which represents the outside face of the glazing when the latter is mounted on the vehicle
requirements.text: The abrasion test shall be carried out on the surface of the test piece representing the outside face of the glazing as mounted on the vehicle.

requirements.quote: Condition the test pieces for a minimum time of 48 hours at 23 °C ± 2 °C and 50 ± 5 per cent relative humidity.
requirements.text: Abrasion test pieces shall be conditioned for at least 48 hours at 23 °C ± 2 °C and 50 ± 5 per cent relative humidity.

requirements.quote: The angle between the normal (perpendicular) to the surface of the test piece and the axis of the light beam shall not exceed 8°.
requirements.text: In the haze measurement the angle between the normal to the test piece surface and the light beam axis shall not exceed 8°.

requirements.quote: For each type of safety glazing, carry out three tests with the same load.
requirements.text: For each type of safety glazing three abrasion tests shall be carried out with the same load.

requirements.quote: The test piece shall be mounted at a 45° angle from the front of the machine as shown in Figure 5.2.
requirements.text: The test piece shall be mounted on the abraser turntable at a 45° angle from the front of the machine.

requirements.quote: Natural quartz sand of grain size of 0.50/0.70 mm, with no oversize, obtained by sieving on wire sieves complying with ISO 565
requirements.text: The sand drop test shall use natural quartz sand of grain size 0.50/0.70 mm with no oversize.

requirements.quote: Three kilograms of 0.50/0.70 mm grain size quartz sand shall drop through a gravity tube from a height of 1.650 mm onto the sample to be tested.
requirements.text: In the sand drop test 3 kg of 0.50/0.70 mm quartz sand shall fall through a gravity tube from a height of 1,650 mm onto the sample.

requirements.quote: rotation speed (127 ± 5) rev/min
requirements.text: The car wash test brush shall rotate at 127 ± 5 rev/min.

requirements.quote: water flow rate (2.2 ± 0.1) l/min. at (300 ± 50) kPa
requirements.text: The car wash test spray nozzles shall deliver a water flow rate of 2.2 ± 0.1 l/min at 300 ± 50 kPa.

requirements.quote: speed (5 ± 0.2) m/min.
requirements.text: The car wash test panel holder shall travel at a feed speed of 5 ± 0.2 m/min.

requirements.quote: Prepare a suspension consisting of (1.5 ± 0.05 g) of silica powder (silica micro-powder having a mean particle size of 24 μm) per litre of tap water
requirements.text: The car wash spray suspension shall contain 1.5 ± 0.05 g of silica micro-powder of mean particle size 24 μm per litre of tap water.

requirements.quote: The size of the samples shall be 50 mm x 100 mm.
requirements.text: Car wash test samples shall measure 50 mm x 100 mm.

requirements.quote: with 37 ± 2 cycles per minute and the possibility to adjust the stroke length (half a wipe cycles) to 130 ± 5 mm
requirements.text: The wiper test apparatus shall provide a back-and-forth motion of 37 ± 2 cycles per minute with a stroke length of 130 ± 5 mm.

requirements.quote: adjusted to provide a load of 15 ± 0.5 g/cm
requirements.text: The wiper blade holder shall apply a load of 15 ± 0.5 g/cm to the test sample.

requirements.quote: 195 ± 1 g water (with a hardness of less than 205 mg/l after evaporation) (97.5 wt.-per cent)
requirements.text: The wiper test aqueous suspension shall contain 195 ± 1 g of water with a hardness of less than 205 mg/l after evaporation.

requirements.quote: 5 ± 0.2 g so called ISO test dust A4 (according to ISO 12103-1)7 (2.5 wt.-per cent)
requirements.text: The wiper test aqueous suspension shall contain 5 ± 0.2 g of ISO test dust A4 according to ISO 12103-1.

requirements.quote: After half of the test cycle numbers 10,000 cycles the test shall be stopped and the two sample boxes shall be exchanged without turning them
requirements.text: The wiper test shall be stopped after 10,000 cycles and the two sample boxes exchanged without turning them.

requirements.quote: Heat to 100 °C +0 °C / -2 °C three samples or three square test pieces of at least 300 mm x 300 mm which have been cut by the laboratory from three windscreens
requirements.text: Three samples or square test pieces of at least 300 mm x 300 mm cut from three windscreens shall be heated to 100 °C +0/-2 °C.

requirements.quote: Maintain this temperature for a period of two hours, then allow the samples or test pieces to cool to room temperature.
requirements.text: The high-temperature test pieces shall be maintained at 100 °C for two hours and then allowed to cool to room temperature.

requirements.quote: bubbles or other defects are not formed more than 15 mm from an uncut edge or 25 mm from a cut edge of the test piece or sample
requirements.text: The windscreen shall pass the high-temperature test only if no bubbles or other defects form more than 15 mm from an uncut edge or 25 mm from a cut edge.

requirements.quote: The arc length shall be 300 mm ± 4 mm. The lamp shall be operated at 750 W ± 50 W.
requirements.text: The radiation source shall be a mercury-vapour arc lamp of 300 mm ± 4 mm arc length operated at 750 W ± 50 W.

requirements.quote: Device for mounting and rotating the test pieces at 1 to 5 rev/min about the centrally-located radiation source
requirements.text: The radiation test pieces shall be rotated at 1 to 5 rev/min about the centrally located radiation source.

requirements.quote: The size of the test pieces shall be 76 mm x 300 mm.
requirements.text: Radiation test pieces shall measure 76 mm x 300 mm.

requirements.quote: Maintain the temperature of the test pieces at 45 °C ± 5 °C throughout the test.
requirements.text: The temperature of the test pieces shall be maintained at 45 °C ± 5 °C throughout the radiation exposure.

requirements.quote: For the type of lamp specified in paragraph 6.1.1.1. the exposure time shall be 100 hours.
requirements.text: The radiation exposure time shall be 100 hours for the specified lamp type.

requirements.quote: The total light transmittance when measured pursuant to paragraphs 9.1.1. and 9.1.2. of this annex does not fall below 95 per cent of the original value before irradiation
requirements.text: After irradiation the light transmittance of the glazing shall not fall below 95 per cent of the original value before irradiation.

requirements.quote: Below 70 per cent in the case of windscreens and other glazing located in a position requisite for driving visibility.
requirements.text: After irradiation the light transmittance of the windscreen and of glazing requisite for driving visibility shall not fall below 70 per cent.

requirements.quote: In the xenon arc exposure apparatus, this temperature shall be 70 °C ± 3 °C as indicated by a Black standard thermometer or equivalent.
requirements.text: During the dry portion of the weathering cycle the black standard temperature shall be 70 °C ± 3 °C.

requirements.quote: The relative humidity within the exposure apparatus shall be controlled at 50 ± 5 per cent during the dry portions of the cycle.
requirements.text: The relative humidity in the weathering apparatus shall be controlled at 50 ± 5 per cent during the dry portions of the cycle.

requirements.quote: The pH of the water shall be between 6.0 and 8.0, and the conductivity shall be less than 5 microsiemens.
requirements.text: The water used for the weathering spray shall have a pH between 6.0 and 8.0 and a conductivity less than 5 microsiemens.

requirements.quote: exposed to light without water spray for 102 minutes and to light with water spray for 18 minutes.
requirements.text: The simulated weathering cycle shall expose test pieces to light without water spray for 102 minutes and to light with water spray for 18 minutes.

requirements.quote: The regular light transmittance measured shall not differ from the original test on unexposed samples by more than 5 per cent
requirements.text: After simulated weathering the regular light transmittance shall not differ from the unexposed value by more than 5 per cent.

requirements.quote: Keep three samples or three square test pieces of at least 300 mm x 300 mm in a vertical position for two weeks in a closed container
requirements.text: Three samples or square test pieces of at least 300 mm x 300 mm shall be kept vertical for two weeks in a closed container.

requirements.quote: in which the temperature is maintained at 50 °C ± 2 °C and the relative humidity at 95 ± 4 per cent
requirements.text: The humidity test container shall be maintained at 50 °C ± 2 °C and 95 ± 4 per cent relative humidity.

requirements.quote: no significant change is observed more than 10 mm from the uncut edges and more than 15 mm from the cut edges
requirements.text: The laminated glazing shall pass the humidity test only if no significant change is observed more than 10 mm from uncut edges and more than 15 mm from cut edges.

requirements.quote: Two test pieces 300 mm x 300 mm shall be placed in an enclosure at a temperature of -40 °C ± 5 °C for a period of 6 hours
requirements.text: Two test pieces of 300 mm x 300 mm shall be placed in an enclosure at -40 °C ± 5 °C for 6 hours.

requirements.quote: These shall then be placed in circulating air at a temperature of 72 °C ± 2 °C for 3 hours.
requirements.text: After the cold phase the test pieces shall be placed in circulating air at 72 °C ± 2 °C for 3 hours.

requirements.quote: if the test pieces do not show any evidence of cracking, clouding, separation of layers or other apparent deterioration
requirements.text: The glazing shall show no cracking, clouding, separation of layers or other apparent deterioration after the temperature-change test.

requirements.quote: The voltage at the lamp filament shall be such that the colour temperature is 2,856 K ± 50 K.
requirements.text: The light source for the light transmission test shall have a colour temperature of 2,856 K ± 50 K.

requirements.quote: The linearity of the receiver and the associated indicating instrument shall be better than 2 per cent of the effective part of the scale.
requirements.text: The light-transmission receiver and its indicating instrument shall be linear to better than 2 per cent of the effective part of the scale.

requirements.quote: the angle of incidence of the light beam is equal to 0 ± 5°
requirements.text: In the light transmission measurement the angle of incidence of the light beam on the test piece shall be 0 ± 5°.

requirements.quote: For the windscreens of M1 Vehicles 18 the test shall be carried out in Test Area B defined in Annex 21, Paragraph 2.3., excluding any opaque obscuration impinging on it.
requirements.text: For an M1 vehicle windscreen the light transmission test shall be carried out in Test Area B defined in Annex 21 paragraph 2.3, excluding any opaque obscuration impinging on it.

requirements.quote: In the case of a windscreen, it shall not be less than 70 per cent.
requirements.text: The regular light transmittance of the windscreen shall not be less than 70 per cent.

requirements.quote: The slides shall be of sufficiently high quality and contrast to enable measurement to be carried out with an error of less than 5 per cent.
requirements.text: The slides used in the optical distortion test shall be of sufficient quality and contrast to allow measurement with an error of less than 5 per cent.

requirements.quote: Mount the windscreen on the support stand (paragraph 9.2.1.2.3.) at the designed rake angle.
requirements.text: The windscreen shall be mounted on the optical distortion support stand at its designed rake angle.

requirements.quote: The distance Δ x shall be 4 mm.
requirements.text: The distance Δx used in the optical distortion evaluation shall be 4 mm.

requirements.quote: Four test pieces shall be submitted for testing.
requirements.text: Four windscreens shall be submitted for the optical distortion test.

requirements.quote: M1 and N1 A - extended according to para. 9.2.2.1. 2' of arc B - reduced according to para. 2.4. of Annex 21 6' of arc
requirements.text: For an M1 windscreen the optical distortion shall not exceed 2' of arc in extended test area A and 6' of arc in reduced test area B.

requirements.quote: No measurements shall be made in a peripheral area 25 mm inboard of the design glass outline and of any opaque obscuration
requirements.text: No optical distortion measurement shall be made in the peripheral area 25 mm inboard of the design glass outline and of any opaque obscuration.

requirements.quote: x is the distance from the safety glazing to the target (not less than 7 m)
requirements.text: In the target secondary-image test the distance from the windscreen to the target shall be at least 7 m.

requirements.quote: The windscreen shall first be examined by a simple scanning technique to establish the area giving the strongest secondary image.
requirements.text: Before the collimation-telescope measurement the windscreen shall first be scanned to establish the area giving the strongest secondary image.

requirements.quote: Four windscreens shall be submitted for testing.
requirements.text: Four windscreens shall be submitted for the secondary-image-separation test.

requirements.quote: M1 and N1 A - extended according to para. 9.2.2.1. 15' of arc B - reduced according to para. 2.4. of Annex 21 25'of arc
requirements.text: For an M1 windscreen the secondary-image separation shall not exceed 15' of arc in extended test area A and 25' of arc in reduced test area B.

requirements.quote: A sample is held horizontally in a U-shaped holder and is exposed to the action of a defined low-energy flame for 15 seconds
requirements.text: The fire-resistance sample shall be held horizontally in a U-shaped holder and exposed to a defined low-energy flame for 15 seconds.

requirements.quote: The combustion chamber is placed on four feet, 10 mm high.
requirements.text: The combustion chamber shall be placed on four feet 10 mm high.

requirements.quote: The plane of the lower side of samples shall be 178 mm above the floor plate.
requirements.text: The lower side of the fire-resistance sample shall lie 178 mm above the floor plate of the chamber.

requirements.quote: having an inside diameter of 9.5 mm
requirements.text: The ignition burner shall have an inside diameter of 9.5 mm.

requirements.quote: The thickness of the sample corresponds to the thickness of the product to be tested. It shall not be more than 13 mm.
requirements.text: The fire-resistance sample thickness shall correspond to the product thickness and shall not exceed 13 mm.

requirements.quote: At least five samples shall be taken from the material under test.
requirements.text: At least five fire-resistance samples shall be taken from the material under test.

requirements.quote: The samples shall be conditioned for at least 24 hours, but not more than 7 days, at a temperature of 23 °C ± 2 °C and a relative humidity of 50 ± 5 per cent
requirements.text: Fire-resistance samples shall be conditioned for at least 24 hours and not more than 7 days at 23 °C ± 2 °C and 50 ± 5 per cent relative humidity.

requirements.quote: Adjust the gas flame to a height of 38 mm using the mark in the chamber, the air intake of the burner being closed.
requirements.text: The gas flame shall be adjusted to a height of 38 mm with the burner air intake closed.

requirements.quote: make sure before starting a test that the temperature of the combustion chamber and sample holder does not exceed 30 °C
requirements.text: Before each fire-resistance test the combustion chamber and sample holder shall be at a temperature not exceeding 30 °C.

requirements.quote: Window-cleaning-solution: an aqueous solution of isopropanol and dipropylene glycol monomethyl ether in concentration between 5 and 10 per cent by weight each
requirements.text: The window-cleaning test solution shall be an aqueous solution of isopropanol and dipropylene glycol monomethyl ether at 5 to 10 per cent by weight each.

requirements.quote: Four samples 180 mm x 25 mm shall be tested for each test and each chemical specified in paragraph 11.1. above
requirements.text: Four samples of 180 mm x 25 mm shall be tested for each chemical in the resistance-to-chemicals test.

requirements.quote: The samples shall be completely immersed in the test fluid and held for one minute, then removed and immediately wiped dry with a clean absorbent cotton cloth.
requirements.text: The chemical-resistance samples shall be completely immersed in the test fluid for one minute, then removed and immediately wiped dry with a clean absorbent cotton cloth.

requirements.quote: The load mass shall be 28.7 . t2 g where t is the thickness in mm of the test specimen.
requirements.text: In the chemicals test under load the applied load mass shall be 28.7 x t² g where t is the specimen thickness in mm.

requirements.quote: if the sample does not exhibit any softening, tackiness, crazing or apparent loss of transparency
requirements.text: The glazing shall show no softening, tackiness, crazing or apparent loss of transparency after exposure to the test chemicals.

requirements.quote: Temperature: 20 °C ± 2 °C Relative humidity: 60 ± 5 per cent
requirements.text: The flexibility and fold test shall be conducted at 20 °C ± 2 °C and 60 ± 5 per cent relative humidity.

requirements.quote: Cut through the coating on to the subsurface a pattern with 6 cuts and perpendicular to this, another one so that a grid with 25 squares arises (grid-cut).
requirements.text: The cross-cut test shall cut through the coating to the substrate with 6 cuts and 6 perpendicular cuts forming a grid of 25 squares.

requirements.quote: The cutting tool should be drawn steadily with a speed of 2 to 5 cm/s so that the cuts reach the subsurface but do not penetrate too deeply.
requirements.text: The cross-cut cutting tool shall be drawn steadily at 2 to 5 cm/s so that the cuts reach the substrate without penetrating too deeply.

requirements.quote: Before each test the test pieces shall be stored for not less than four hours at a temperature of 23 °C ± 2 °C.
requirements.text: Before each test on the ordinary laminated windscreen the test pieces shall be stored for at least four hours at 23 °C ± 2 °C.

requirements.quote: The drop height shall be 1.5 m +0/-5 mm.
requirements.text: The headform test on the complete laminated windscreen shall be performed with a drop height of 1.5 m +0/-5 mm.

requirements.quote: the cracks nearest to the point of impact being not more than 80 mm from it
requirements.text: On headform impact the laminated windscreen shall break with numerous circular cracks centred on the impact point, the nearest crack being not more than 80 mm from it.

requirements.quote: The layers of glass shall remain adhering to the plastics-material interlayer.
requirements.text: After the headform impact the glass layers of the windscreen shall remain adhering to the plastics interlayer.

requirements.quote: The interlayer shall not be laid bare over an area of more than 20 cm2
requirements.text: On the impact side of the windscreen the interlayer shall not be laid bare over an area exceeding 20 cm².

requirements.quote: A tear in the interlayer up to a length of 35 mm is allowed.
requirements.text: A tear in the windscreen interlayer of up to 35 mm in length shall be permitted.

requirements.quote: Twelve square test pieces of 300 mm +10/-0 mm side shall be subjected to testing.
requirements.text: Twelve square test pieces of 300 mm +10/-0 mm side shall be subjected to the 2,260 g ball test.

requirements.quote: The height of drop (from the underface of the ball to the upper face of the test piece) shall be 4 m +25/-0 mm.
requirements.text: The 2,260 g ball shall be dropped from 4 m +25/-0 mm onto the laminated glazing test piece.

requirements.quote: the ball does not pass through the glazing within five seconds after the moment of impact
requirements.text: The laminated glazing shall prevent the 2,260 g ball from passing through within five seconds after impact.

requirements.quote: if at least eleven of the twelve tests have given a satisfactory result
requirements.text: The laminated windscreen shall pass the 2,260 g ball test when at least eleven of the twelve tests give a satisfactory result.

requirements.quote: Twenty square test pieces of 300 mm +10/-0 mm side shall be subjected to testing.
requirements.text: Twenty square test pieces of 300 mm +10/-0 mm side shall be subjected to the 227 g ball test.

requirements.quote: Ten test pieces shall be tested at a temperature of +40 °C ± 2 °C and ten at a temperature of -20 °C ± 2 °C.
requirements.text: Ten of the 227 g ball test pieces shall be tested at +40 °C ± 2 °C and ten at -20 °C ± 2 °C.
For a laminated windscreen of nominal thickness up to 4.5 mm the 227 g ball drop height shall be 9 m at +40 °C and 8.5 m at -20 °C with a maximum permitted fragment mass of 12 g.

requirements.quote: If the interlayer is not torn, the weight of fragments detached from the side of the glass opposite to the point of impact shall not exceed the appropriate values specified
requirements.text: Where the interlayer of the windscreen is not torn, the weight of fragments detached from the side opposite the impact shall not exceed the specified maximum permitted mass.

requirements.quote: the light scatter as a result of abrasion of the test piece does not exceed 2 per cent
requirements.text: The light scatter of the laminated windscreen resulting from 1,000 abrasion cycles shall not exceed 2 per cent.

requirements.quote: The requirements of Annex 3, paragraph 7., shall apply.
requirements.text: The ordinary laminated windscreen shall be subjected to the resistance-to-humidity test requirements of Annex 3 paragraph 7.

requirements.quote: Tears in the interlayer are allowed, but the manikin's head shall not pass through
requirements.text: In the headform test on the /D laminated pane tears in the interlayer shall be permitted but the headform shall not pass through.

requirements.quote: the ball does not pass through the glazing within five seconds after the moment of impact
requirements.text: The /D laminated pane shall prevent the 2,260 g ball from passing through within five seconds after impact.

requirements.quote: Eight flat samples measuring 300 mm x 300 mm, specially made or cut from the flattest part of a pane shall be tested
requirements.text: Eight flat samples of 300 mm x 300 mm cut from the flattest part of the pane shall be subjected to the 227 g ball test.

requirements.quote: The height of drop from the underface of the ball to the upper face of the test piece or sample shall be 9 m +25 mm / -0 mm.
requirements.text: The 227 g ball drop height for the laminated pane shall be 9 m +25/-0 mm.

requirements.quote: The laminate shall not break into separate pieces
requirements.text: On 227 g ball impact the laminated pane shall not break into separate pieces.

requirements.quote: the light scatter as a result of abrasion of the test piece does not exceed 2 per cent
requirements.text: The light scatter of the laminated pane after 1,000 abrasion cycles shall not exceed 2 per cent.

requirements.quote: The requirements concerning optical qualities set out in Annex 3, paragraph 9., shall apply to every type of windscreen.
requirements.text: Every windscreen type shall meet the optical quality requirements of Annex 3 paragraph 9.

requirements.quote: The number of fragments in any 5 cm x 5 cm square is not less than 40.
requirements.text: In the fragmentation test of the uniformly toughened pane the number of fragments in any 5 cm x 5 cm square shall not be less than 40.

requirements.quote: Fragments of an area exceeding 3 cm2 shall not be allowed except in the parts defined in paragraph 2.6.1.3. above.
requirements.text: No fragment of the toughened pane larger than 3 cm² shall be allowed outside the excluded edge and impact areas.

requirements.quote: The height of drop (from the underface of the ball to the upper surface of the test piece) shall be 2.0 m +5/-0 mm.
requirements.text: The 227 g ball drop height for the uniformly toughened glass pane shall be 2.0 m +5/-0 mm.

requirements.quote: the test shall be deemed to have given a satisfactory result if at least five of the test pieces do not break
requirements.text: The toughened pane shall pass the 227 g ball test when at least five of the six test pieces do not break.

requirements.quote: The nominal thickness 'e' of the windscreen, a manufacturing tolerance of 0.2 . n mm ('n' being the number of layers of glass in the windscreen) above or below the nominal value being allowed
requirements.text: The nominal thickness of the laminated windscreen shall be held within ±0.2 x n mm of the nominal value, n being the number of glass layers.

requirements.quote: Safety glazing shall be fitted in such a way that, despite the stresses to which the vehicle is submitted under normal conditions of use
requirements.text: The windscreen and side glazing shall be fitted so that, despite the stresses of normal use, they remain in position and continue to afford visibility and safety to the occupants.

requirements.quote: Safety glazing shall bear the appropriate component type-approval mark specified in paragraph 5.4. of this Regulation, followed when required, by one of the additional symbols provided for in paragraph 5.5.
requirements.text: Each pane fitted to the vehicle shall bear the component type-approval mark of paragraph 5.4 and, where required, the additional symbol of paragraph 5.5.

requirements.quote: The regular light transmittance shall not be less than 70 per cent.
requirements.text: The windscreen as fitted to the M1 vehicle shall have a regular light transmittance of not less than 70 per cent.

requirements.quote: The windscreen shall be correctly fitted with reference to the vehicle driver's "R" point.
requirements.text: The windscreen shall be correctly fitted with reference to the vehicle driver's "R" point.

requirements.quote: Vehicles having a maximum design speed greater than 40 km/h may not be fitted with a toughened windscreen.
requirements.text: The M1 vehicle, whose maximum design speed exceeds 40 km/h, shall not be fitted with a toughened windscreen.

requirements.quote: The safety glazing through which the driver's forwards field of vision as defined in paragraph 2.25.1. of this Regulation is obtained, shall have a regular light transmittance of at least 70 per cent.
requirements.text: The side glazing through which the driver's forward field of vision is obtained shall have a regular light transmittance of at least 70 per cent.

requirements.quote: A vehicle and its electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.text: Any electrical/electronic component of the glazing system (e.g. heated glazing or sensors bonded to the windscreen) shall be designed, constructed and fitted so that the vehicle complies with this Regulation in normal conditions of use.

requirements.quote: ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.
requirements.text: An electrical/electronic sub-assembly fitted with the glazing shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions and for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 32 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band and 32 to 43 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz frequency band
requirements.text: At a 10.0 ± 0.2 m antenna-to-vehicle spacing the broadband radiation of the vehicle shall not exceed 32 dBµV/m in 30 to 75 MHz and 32 to 43 dBµV/m in 75 to 400 MHz.

requirements.quote: In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 43 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.text: Between 400 and 1,000 MHz the vehicle broadband radiation limit shall remain constant at 43 dBµV/m.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band and 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz frequency band
requirements.text: At a 3.0 ± 0.05 m antenna-to-vehicle spacing the broadband radiation of the vehicle shall not exceed 42 dBµV/m in 30 to 75 MHz and 42 to 53 dBµV/m in 75 to 400 MHz.

requirements.quote: the measured values, expressed in dB microvolts/m shall be below the type approval limits
requirements.text: The broadband emission values measured on the representative vehicle shall be below the type approval limits.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 28 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 230 MHz frequency band and 35 dB microvolts/m in the 230 to 1,000 MHz frequency band
requirements.text: At a 10.0 ± 0.2 m spacing the narrowband radiation of the vehicle shall not exceed 28 dBµV/m in 30 to 230 MHz and 35 dBµV/m in 230 to 1,000 MHz.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 38 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 230 MHz frequency band and 45 dB microvolts/m in the 230 to 1,000 MHz frequency band
requirements.text: At a 3.0 ± 0.05 m spacing the narrowband radiation of the vehicle shall not exceed 38 dBµV/m in 30 to 230 MHz and 45 dBµV/m in 230 to 1,000 MHz.

requirements.quote: the field strength shall be 30 volts/m in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band and a minimum of 25 volts/m over the whole 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band
requirements.text: The vehicle shall withstand a radiated field of 30 V/m over 90 per cent of 20 to 2,000 MHz and a minimum of 25 V/m over the whole 20 to 2,000 MHz band.

requirements.quote: The field strength shall be 10 volts/m in over 90 per cent of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency band and a minimum of 8 volts/m over the whole 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall withstand a radiated field of 10 V/m over 90 per cent of 2,000 to 6,000 MHz and a minimum of 8 V/m over the whole 2,000 to 6,000 MHz band.

requirements.quote: there shall be no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions", according to paragraph 2.1. of Annex 6
requirements.text: During the immunity tests there shall be no degradation of performance of the immunity-related functions, including driver visibility functions such as the windscreen wiper.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz
requirements.text: The broadband electromagnetic interference of the ESA shall not exceed 62 to 52 dBµV/m in 30 to 75 MHz, decreasing logarithmically with frequency.

requirements.quote: 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz
requirements.text: The broadband interference of the ESA shall comply with 52 to 63 dBµV/m in 75 to 400 MHz, increasing logarithmically above 75 MHz.

requirements.quote: In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.text: The ESA broadband interference limit shall remain constant at 63 dBµV/m between 400 and 1,000 MHz.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz
requirements.text: The narrowband electromagnetic interference of the ESA shall not exceed 52 to 42 dBµV/m in 30 to 75 MHz, decreasing logarithmically with frequency.

requirements.quote: 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz
requirements.text: The ESA narrowband interference shall comply with 42 to 53 dBµV/m in 75 to 400 MHz, increasing logarithmically above 75 MHz.

requirements.quote: Positive +75 V +150 V Negative -100 V -450 V
requirements.text: The transient conducted disturbances emitted by the ESA on 12 V supply lines shall not exceed +75 V positive and -100 V negative, and on 24 V lines +150 V positive and -450 V negative.

requirements.quote: 60 V/m 75 V/m 60 mA 30 V/m 21 V/m
requirements.text: Below 2 GHz the ESA shall withstand, over 90 per cent of the band, 60 V/m in stripline, 75 V/m in TEM cell, 60 mA BCI, 30 V/m ALSE and 21 V/m reverberation chamber.
Above 2 GHz the ESA shall withstand 10 V/m in ALSE and 7 V/m in a reverberation chamber over 90 per cent of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz band.
Below 2 GHz the minimum ESA immunity level over the whole band shall be 50 V/m stripline, 62.5 V/m TEM cell, 50 mA BCI, 25 V/m ALSE and 18 V/m reverberation chamber.

requirements.quote: there shall be no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions"
requirements.text: During the ESA radiated-immunity tests there shall be no degradation of performance of the immunity-related functions.

requirements.quote: The immunity of ESA representative of this type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 16750-2 for starting profile and ISO 7637-2 for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b
requirements.text: The ESA shall be tested for immunity to conducted transients using the ISO 16750-2 starting profile and ISO 7637-2 pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b.

requirements.quote: 2a +37 V +37 V 500 pulses I III
requirements.text: The ESA related to immunity functions shall withstand ISO 7637-2 pulse 2a of +37 V with 500 pulses at functional status class I.

requirements.quote: Where a vehicle or electrical/electronic system or ESA does not include an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz, it shall be deemed to comply
requirements.text: Where the glazing-related electronic device contains no oscillator above 9 kHz it shall be deemed to comply with the narrowband emission limits.

requirements.quote: A circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.
requirements.text: The approval mark on the vehicle or ESA shall comprise a circle containing the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.

requirements.quote: The number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle specified in paragraph 5.3.1. above.
requirements.text: The approval mark shall include the number of this Regulation, the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle.

requirements.quote: An approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. below shall be affixed to every ESA conforming to a type approved under this Regulation.
requirements.text: An approval mark shall be affixed to every electrical/electronic sub-assembly conforming to an approved type.

requirements.quote: Markings on ESAs in conformity with paragraph 5.3. above need not be visible when the ESA is installed in the vehicle.
requirements.text: The ESA approval mark need not be visible once the ESA is installed in the vehicle.

requirements.quote: a = 6 mm min
requirements.text: The characters of the approval mark shall have a minimum dimension of 6 mm.

requirements.quote: The sample(s) shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.
requirements.text: The ESA sample shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.

requirements.quote: The engine shall be in operation according to CISPR 12.
requirements.text: During the broadband emission measurement the vehicle engine shall be in operation according to CISPR 12.

requirements.quote: All equipment capable of generating broadband emissions which can be switched on permanently by the driver or passenger should be in operation in maximum load
requirements.text: All equipment capable of generating broadband emissions such as wiper motors shall be operated at maximum load during the measurement.

requirements.quote: The limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or an outdoor test site (OTS).
requirements.text: The vehicle broadband emission limits shall apply over the whole 30 to 1,000 MHz range when measured in an ALSE or OTS.

requirements.quote: If peak detectors are used, a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied.
requirements.text: Where peak detectors are used for the emission measurement a 20 dB correction factor as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied.

requirements.quote: Measurements shall be made on the left and right sides of the vehicle.
requirements.text: Radiated emission measurements shall be made on both the left and right sides of the vehicle.

requirements.quote: The ignition switch shall be switched on. The engine shall not be operating.
requirements.text: During the narrowband emission measurement the vehicle ignition shall be switched on and the engine shall not be operating.

requirements.quote: Measurements shall be performed with an average detector.
requirements.text: Narrowband emission measurements shall be performed with an average detector.

requirements.quote: The vehicle shall be monitored during the tests.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall be monitored during the immunity tests to detect any degradation of the immunity-related functions.

requirements.quote: The engine shall normally turn the driving wheels at a steady speed of 50 km/h
requirements.text: In the 50 km/h immunity test mode the engine shall turn the driving wheels at a steady speed of 50 km/h.

requirements.quote: Front wiper ON (manual mode) maximum speed Complete stop of front wiper
requirements.text: During the 50 km/h immunity test the front wiper shall be ON in manual mode at maximum speed and a complete stop of the front wiper shall constitute a failure.

requirements.quote: The vehicle shall be exposed to electromagnetic radiation in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges in vertical polarization.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall be exposed to vertically polarised electromagnetic radiation over the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range.

requirements.quote: AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range
requirements.text: In the 20 to 400 MHz range the immunity test signal shall be amplitude modulated with 1 kHz and 80 per cent modulation depth.

requirements.quote: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably at maximum load, during the emission measurement.

requirements.quote: All of the harnesses shall be placed on a non-conductive, low relative permittivity material (εr ≤ 1.4), at 50 mm (±5 mm) above the ground plane.
requirements.text: The ESA harnesses shall be placed on a non-conductive material with εr ≤ 1.4 at 50 ± 5 mm above the ground plane.

requirements.quote: the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.5.2.1. of this Regulation
requirements.text: The ambient noise during the ESA emission measurement shall be at least 6 dB below the interference limits of paragraph 6.5.2.1.

requirements.quote: Measurements shall be performed with an average detector.
requirements.text: ESA narrowband emission measurements shall be performed with an average detector.

requirements.quote: Absorber chamber test according to ISO 11452-2
requirements.text: The ESA immunity to electromagnetic radiation may be demonstrated by the absorber chamber test according to ISO 11452-2.

requirements.quote: The ESA under test shall be switched on and shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.
requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be switched on and stimulated to be in its normal operation condition during the immunity tests.

requirements.quote: No extraneous equipment shall be closer than 1 m from the reference point during calibration.
requirements.text: During calibration no extraneous equipment shall be closer than 1 m from the reference point.

requirements.quote: The "substitution method" shall be used to establish the test field conditions according to ISO 11452-2. The test shall be performed with vertical polarization.
requirements.text: The absorber chamber immunity test shall use the substitution method of ISO 11452-2 and shall be performed with vertical polarisation.

requirements.quote: BCI test method with substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA
requirements.text: The bulk current injection test shall use the substitution method with the injection probe positioned 150 mm from the ESA.

requirements.quote: This test method shall ensure the immunity of ESAs to conducted transients on the vehicle power supply and limit conducted transients from ESAs to the vehicle power supply.
requirements.text: The ESA shall be immune to conducted transients on the vehicle power supply and shall limit the conducted transients it feeds back to the supply.

requirements.quote: ESAs that are exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles (vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor) are not subject to starting profile.
requirements.text: An ESA reserved exclusively for mounting on electric vehicles without a 12 V/24 V starter motor shall not be subject to the starting profile test.

requirements.quote: The vehicle shall be placed directly on the ground plane.
requirements.text: For the electrical fast transient/burst test the vehicle shall be placed directly on the ground plane.

requirements.quote: The electrical fast transient/burst (EFT/B) shall be applied on the vehicle on the AC/DC power lines in common modes by using CDN
requirements.text: The electrical fast transient/burst shall be applied to the vehicle on its AC/DC power lines in common mode using a coupling/decoupling network.

requirements.quote: The electrical surge shall be applied on the vehicle on the AC/DC power lines between each line and earth and between lines by using CDN
requirements.text: The surge shall be applied to the vehicle on its AC/DC power lines between each line and earth and between lines using a coupling/decoupling network.

requirements.quote: the levels measured do not exceed by more than 4 dB (60 per cent) the reference limits prescribed
requirements.text: For conformity of production the measured emission levels shall not exceed the reference limits by more than 4 dB.
